prompts.label: 美方代表
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Life World international-dialogue demo role portrait, an original completely fictional adult person, NOT any actual politician or official. Square 1024x1024 composition. Style/medium: warm restrained storybook/editorial digital painting, mature dignified proportions, softly painterly brushwork, simplified calm background, coherent gentle LifeWorld UI. Palette: warm cream backdrop, muted mint and sage, subtle light-gold accents and subdued charcoal/navy tailoring. Composition: centered head and shoulders, upper chest visible, face upright looking just off-camera, hair fully inside frame, generous 13% headroom and side margins suitable for circular UI crop; no frame or circular outline. Soft daylight and equal calm attentive neutral expression, no exaggerated emotional coding. No text, letters, captions, logos, flags, seals, lapel badges, real-world institutional branding, watermarks, podiums, or national symbols. Fictional likeness only; not a portrait of a real person. Nothing should suggest an authentic official photograph. Render one finished portrait only.
Subject: fictional woman in her early fifties, medium-brown skin, a rounded face, short natural dark curls with silver strands at the temples, brown eyes, warm ivory blouse under a muted navy tailored blazer; no tie, glasses or jewelry. This is simply the fictional US-side representative in a hypothetical educational negotiation; nationality does not determine personality.
